description:
Primary responsibility is to architect, develop, maintain and collaborate in the development of a web-based Microsoft .Net and MVC-based applications, including analyzing and developing using C# and SQL Server 2012, as well as Microsoft Office 2007+. 
 The role includes working with systems architects, the application development lead, and other team members to develop and assess functional requirements, develop system flow charts, and document development activities. 
 The role also requires working on all aspects of the software development life cycle (SDLC). 
 Must also be able to interact with client teams and interpret document requirements. 
 Writes code for the assigned application, validates code/functionality, performs unit and functional testing, ensures that programming is easy to read and understand. 

 - Minimum of three years of .Net and MVC development experience 
 - Web application development experience using Microsoft .Net (4.0 or above) MVC using C# 
 - Strong SQL query skills including stored procedures (knowledge of SQL Server 2012 or above preferred) 
 - HTML/HTML5 
 - Javascript 
 - JQuery 
 - AJAX 
 - XML 
 - Familiarity with one or more common web application frameworks 
 - Proven ability to work under pressure with minimal supervision 
 - Demonstrated excellent interpersonal and leadership skills 
 - A team player that can work collaboratively in a team environment 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
 - Strong attention to detail 
 - A team player with the ability to interact cohesively in a team environment 
 - Comfort with Microsoft Office products 
 - Demonstrated abilities to handle multiple concurrent projects effectively with varying tasks and priorities and minimal supervision 
 - The candidate must be motivated, inquisitive and able to readily take ownership of responsibilities
